about.headline: Comfortable between business questions and technical details.
about.text: I'm a Data Operations Coordinator with a background in computer science, software development, and quality assurance. My work centers around helping different parts of an organization get accurate, reliable information from their data. On any given day that might mean writing SQL queries, building reports, preparing marketing audiences, validating imports, troubleshooting inconsistencies between systems, or improving recurring workflows with Excel and Power Query. I enjoy taking processes that are manual, confusing, or difficult to maintain and making them simpler, more reliable, and easier for other teams to use. One of the parts of the job I enjoy most is translating technical details into information that other departments can actually use.

resume.headline: Practical data operations support with software engineering roots.
resume.text: Ryan brings experience in SQL reporting, Excel/VBA automation, Power Query workflows, iPost Enterprise data prep, Salesforce reporting, migration support, QA-style troubleshooting, and documentation for non-technical handoff.
